correctness.rationale: Using a=2^p and b=3^p, the compressed powered-distance form on the real mean-zero space has n(t−1) internal leaf directions with eigenvalue −a, n−1 identical two-by-two blocks with first entry −1 and determinant t[b+a−a²−1+a/t], and the contrast (−t on cores, +1 on leaves) with form nt²H. Concavity gives H<0 and positive block determinants for 0≤p≤1, including the specified diagonal convention at p=0. H is increasing from −2/t to 2n−4/t on [1,2] and strictly increasing thereafter. For 1<p≤α, H≤0 gives det/t≥nF−(a−2)²>0: F≥(a−2)²/2 follows from strict concavity of a^(log_2 3)−a²/2−1 on [2,4]. Thus only the global contrast is null at α, giving centered Gram rank N−2, versus N−1 below. A distinct-point Euclidean realization gives strictly positive Gaussian kernels even at α; above α the first-order expansion on the global contrast produces a negative direction at small positive scales, and the unit diagonal gives a positive direction. H increases in either integer size at fixed p>1, and Taylor expansion at 1 with slope (n−1)c+2(1−1/t)log 2 and α−1≤2/[t(n−1)c] gives both asymptotic orders. Independent bisection gives the two stated numerical anchors (1.70951129135145 and 1.38018235538565); these are illustrative, not a proof. The original checker and its recorded replay were inspected, not re-executed.
